workarounds.symptom: A 16-bit PNG crashes `erase`, quietly corrupts the LaMa fill, and comes out of the metadata strip at 8 bits
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep a 16-bit source at 16 bits through the fill and the metadata strip. Target files: src/remove_ai_watermarks/forensic_metadata.py, src/remove_ai_watermarks/metadata.py, src/remove_ai_watermarks/region_eraser.py. A 16-bit PNG didn't survive either half of the pixel path, and it failed three different ways: `cv2.inpaint` blew up with a raw `icvInpaint` error, `erase_lama` divided the crop by a hardcoded 255 and quietly filled the mask with near-black pixels, and the metadata strip handed the whole file back a... (Ref: https://github.com/wiltodelta/remove-ai-watermarks/pull/101)
